requirements.text: The game is called 'Crumb Chase'.
requirements.check: The game window title displays 'Crumb Chase'.
requirements.quote: Create a small one-screen maze game called "Crumb Chase".

requirements.text: The game features a 15x15 grid maze.
requirements.check: The game displays a grid of 15x15 tiles with walls.
requirements.quote: simple grid maze of 15 by 15 tiles with walls.

requirements.text: The player controls a green mouse.
requirements.check: A green shape representing the mouse is visible on the screen.
requirements.quote: The player is a little green mouse

requirements.text: Arrow keys turn the mouse up, down, left, or right.
requirements.check: Pressing an arrow key changes the mouse's direction of movement.
requirements.quote: The arrow keys turn the mouse up, down, left or right

requirements.text: The mouse moves tile by tile in the chosen direction until it hits a wall.
requirements.check: After pressing an arrow key, the mouse moves continuously in that direction until it reaches a wall tile.
requirements.quote: it keeps moving tile by tile in that direction until it hits a wall.

requirements.text: Every open tile starts with a small cheese crumb.
requirements.check: All non-wall tiles initially display a small crumb shape.
requirements.quote: Every open tile starts with a small cheese crumb

requirements.text: Eating a crumb adds 10 points to the score.
requirements.check: When the mouse moves onto a tile with a crumb, the crumb disappears, and the score increases by 10.
requirements.quote: eating a crumb adds 10 points.

requirements.text: Two cats wander the maze.
requirements.check: Two distinct shapes representing cats are visible and move within the maze.
requirements.quote: Two cats wander the maze

requirements.text: Each cat moves one tile at a time.
requirements.check: Cats move from one tile to an adjacent tile at regular intervals.
requirements.quote: each cat moves one tile at a time

requirements.text: At each junction, a cat picks a direction toward the mouse.
requirements.check: When a cat reaches a junction (more than two open paths), it chooses a path that reduces its Manhattan distance to the mouse.
requirements.quote: at each junction picks a direction toward the mouse.

requirements.text: If a cat touches the mouse, the mouse loses a life.
requirements.check: When a cat occupies the same tile as the mouse, the 'Lives' counter decreases by 1.
requirements.quote: If a cat touches the mouse, the mouse loses a life

requirements.text: Upon losing a life, the mouse and cats return to their start tiles.
requirements.check: After a collision, the mouse and both cats instantly teleport to their initial positions.
requirements.quote: everyone returns to their start tiles.

requirements.text: The mouse has 3 lives.
requirements.check: The 'Lives' display starts at 3.
requirements.quote: The mouse has 3 lives.

requirements.text: Eating every crumb wins the game.
requirements.check: When the last crumb is eaten, the game state changes to 'WIN'.
requirements.quote: Eating every crumb wins the game

requirements.text: Losing all lives ends the game.
requirements.check: When 'Lives' reaches 0, the game state changes to 'GAME OVER'.
requirements.quote: losing all lives ends the game.

requirements.text: Show the score and lives at the top of the window.
requirements.check: Text displaying 'Score: X' and 'Lives: Y' is visible at the top of the game window and updates correctly.
requirements.quote: Show the score and lives at the top of the window.

requirements.text: When the game is won or over, show WIN or GAME OVER with the final score and freeze the game.
requirements.check: Upon winning or losing, 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' text appears with the final score, and all game movement stops.
requirements.quote: When the game is won or over, show WIN or GAME OVER with the final score and freeze the game.

requirements.text: Press R to restart with 3 lives and score 0.
requirements.check: Pressing 'R' resets the game to its initial state: mouse and cats at start, 3 lives, 0 score, all crumbs present.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart with 3 lives and score 0

requirements.text: Press Escape to quit.
requirements.check: Pressing 'Escape' closes the game window.
requirements.quote: and Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: TURN UP, TURN DOWN, TURN LEFT, TURN RIGHT, RESTART and QUIT.
requirements.check: The console outputs the specified text when the corresponding control is activated.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: TURN UP, TURN DOWN, TURN LEFT, TURN RIGHT, RESTART and QUIT

requirements.text: Print WIN or GAME OVER when the game ends.
requirements.check: The console outputs 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' when the game reaches an end state.
requirements.quote: and print WIN or GAME OVER when the game ends.

requirements.text: Use plain coloured shapes only; no images or sounds.
requirements.check: All visual elements are rendered using basic geometric shapes and solid colors; no image files are loaded, and no sounds are played.
requirements.quote: Use plain coloured shapes only; no images or sounds.

files.purpose: Main game logic, Pygame setup, game loop, event handling, rendering.
Classes for Mouse, Cat, and Crumb entities.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly states 'plain coloured shapes only; no images or sounds', so all assets will be drawn programmatically.

architecture.test_input_example: Press RIGHT, then UP, then LEFT, then DOWN to navigate the maze. Press R to restart. Press ESC to quit.
